question: How often does the registered presence reader answer yes on SENTiVENT sentences that report an asserted, non-negated event?
one_change: read the 1408 validation and test sentences of SENTiVENT once with the registered reader, scoring only

baseline.model: a coin flip on yes or no

prediction.metric: yes rate of answered anchor-positive sentences
prediction.why: the registered reader answers no on 89 percent of news items (always-no 0.891) and was trained on headline plus teaser; a 200-sentence smoke gave no yes at all on either group; body sentences of company events are a different text than the training items, so a low yes rate is expected and would show that the presence field is narrower than an event happened
